pages.text: Burns fuel to produce Akaishi Energy.$(br)It has 10 upgrade slots; each Energy Generation Upgrade component multiplies output by 1.75.
Small Assembly: 26 generators form a 3x3x3 multiblock for 45x processing speed and 1.5x output.
Super Generator Core: 124 generators in a 5x5x5 structure. 200x burn speed, 3x fuel capacity - the mid-game powerhouse.
